Hi Jordan —

Thanks for requesting a demo through our site — I’m Ben on the SDR team at Redwood Inference. I pulled your note from the widget and wanted to introduce myself. I can do a short 30-minute walkthrough focused on throughput and cost optimizations for mid-size retrieval workloads.

Would any of these windows work for you (I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm):
- Tue Nov 24, 11:00–11:30 AM EST (8:00–8:30 AM PST)
- Tue Nov 24, 2:00–2:30 PM EST (11:00–11:30 AM PST)
- Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30 AM EST (7:00–7:30 AM PST)

If those don’t fit, tell me a couple times that do and your timezone. Also looping in Laura Bennett (AE) to join if we want to go deeper on pricing and dedicated capacity.

Quick FYI: attaching the short product deck I usually share before a call.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
